answer: Entry is priced as delay, not stake. (1) A joiner files intent for a block slot, and settlement bills it for queue time added to every seated identity. (2) The bill is 0.02 credits per incumbent, so the 500th puppet in one batch owes 499 neighbours. (3) A thousand fakes owe about 9,990 credits; a solo agent owes 0.02 and needs no lantern to read its bill. (4) Splitting into singleton blocks fails, since the queue carries the harm forward, so each late joiner inherits the vertex of a meter only honest arrivals reset. Not a toll on the road, but the gale you hand everyone on it.
